12	The player finds themselves in a small, circular room lit in soft liminal-space pastels. At the center sits an armchair facing an old-fashioned CRT television with rabbit-ear antennas. A remote control rests on the right arm of the chair.

14	The player can pick up the remote using the IWSDK grab system. Using the remote they can power the TV on or off, and cycle through 6 channels. Each channel renders a fully immersive Gaussian splat world — powered by spark.js — contained within the TV screen itself.
